scenarios.title: Steady transition
scenarios.description: Use historical skill demand as the baseline. No additional emphasis on individual skills.

scenarios.title: Faster AI adoption
scenarios.description: What if AI adoption accelerates? Double the importance of AI/ML foundations, with extra emphasis on Python. This is a planning assumption, not a measured forecast.

scenarios.title: Human-centred transition
scenarios.description: What if collaboration, interpretation and responsible delivery matter more? Double the importance of Agile, data analysis and visualisation. This is a planning assumption, not a measured forecast.

roles.name: Software Engineer / Developer
roles.project: Build an accessible, multilingual job-search tool and test it with people with different accessibility needs.
roles.outlook: Related global WEF signal: Software and Application Developers are expected to grow. This is not a numeric Malaysian forecast.

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.project: Create a reproducible pipeline for public energy-use data, including quality checks and a documented data dictionary.
roles.outlook: Related global WEF signal: Big Data Specialists are expected to grow. Data Engineer is a related taxonomy mapping, not an exact source forecast.

roles.name: Data Scientist
roles.project: Analyse public air-quality data, communicate uncertainty and explain how results could support healthier communities.
roles.outlook: Related global WEF signal: Big Data Specialists are expected to grow. Data Scientist is a related taxonomy mapping, not an exact source forecast.

roles.name: Machine Learning / AI Engineer
roles.project: Prototype an accessible public-health information classifier. Document bias, privacy limits and the need for human review; do not deploy it for diagnosis.
roles.outlook: Related global WEF signal: AI and Machine Learning Specialists are expected to grow. This is not a numeric Malaysian forecast.

roles.name: Cloud Engineer
roles.project: Deploy a small service with resource monitoring, right-sizing notes and an energy-efficiency improvement plan.
roles.outlook: No direct Cloud Engineer forecast is established by the source. Explore this role using historical Malaysian skills and the infrastructure scenario, not an invented growth claim.
